blurb: Parker Helicopters offers four unique helicopter tours showcasing Salt Lake City, the Wasatch Mountains, Antelope Island, and a combined Catch All tour. Tours range from 30 minutes to 1 hour, providing aerial views of urban landmarks, mountain peaks, and natural landscapes. Flights are conducted in a 2018 Robinson R66 helicopter with seating for three passengers plus pilot.
